entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-15
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • EF Core 11 regression: InvalidCastException projecting JSON complex types #39670
  • enum.ToString() on a numeric enum column is typed nvarchar(max) on SQL Server #39667

Closed

  • Add query translation support for new tuple-returning Join overloads (without a result selector) #38047
    12.0-preview1
  • Selecting the latest related entity generates ROW_NUMBER over unrelated rows despite parent filtering #39615
  • Detect via ChangeTracker if a modified CollectionEntry was added or removed #24129
  • ComplexCollection + ToJson(): DetectChanges throws "must be initialized to a non-null value" when a nullable nested complex property containing a collection is set to null #38632
    10.0.13
  • Better translation for COUNT with predicate checking for non-null #26940
    12.0-preview1
  • Temporal query runs as a cached plain AsNoTracking query of the same shape #39583
    12.0-preview1

PullRequests

Created

  • [release/10.0] Fix JSON complex property projections with identity resolution #39671
  • Add configurable SQL Server throttling retry delay #39669
    community-contribution
  • Handle interface collections during SQL pregeneration #39668
    community-contribution
  • Drop removed database-level annotations after table and column operations #39666
    community-contribution
  • Preserve array-to-span conversion when precompiling queries #39665
    community-contribution
  • [release/11.0] Warn when collection properties are mapped as scalars #39664
  • [release/11.0] Preserve owned replacements when original is requeried #39663
  • [release/11.0] Persist null complex properties on TPH siblings with shared columns #39662
  • Identify rows of temporal range queries by their period #39661
    community-contribution
  • Propagate column nullability from failed CASE tests to later clauses #39660
    community-contribution

Merged

  • Translate Join/LeftJoin/RightJoin/FullJoin overloads without a result selector #39612
    community-contribution, api-review
  • Translate a not-null predicate on Count/LongCount over a grouping to COUNT(x) #39503
    community-contribution, api-review, 12.0-preview1
  • Don't serve a temporal query from a cached plain query of the same shape #39590
    community-contribution, 12.0-preview1

Updated

  • Translate SelectMany over a grouping by flattening its rows #39602
    community-contribution
  • Resolve grouping aggregates to the query SQL evaluates them in #39451
    community-contribution
  • Lift GroupBy aggregates over navigations reached through an element s… #38960
    community-contribution
  • Place the model snapshot in --output-dir when it is specified #39565
    community-contribution
  • Count a reused parameterized collection once when checking the SQL Server parameter limit #39634
    community-contribution
  • Throw for proxy navigations whose accessors cannot be overridden #39591
    community-contribution
  • Throw for change-tracking proxy properties whose setters cannot be overridden #39592
    community-contribution
  • Discover the migrations-bundle DbContext out-of-process so publish doesn't lock the assembly #38456
    community-contribution, 12.0.0
  • Translate primitive collections projected through set operations #39561
    community-contribution
  • Make service provider context discovery best-effort in the tools #39562
    community-contribution
  • Add an EFMigrationsOutputDir project property as the default --output-dir #39568
    community-contribution
  • Let migrations remove find the migration files via --output-dir #39567
    community-contribution
  • Add model-wide and member JSON reader/writer configuration #39483
    api-review, area-harness
  • Translate DateTime/DateTimeOffset.AddMicroseconds on SQL Server #39623
    community-contribution
  • Support && and || null checks in conditional projection member access #39636
    community-contribution
  • Translate LINQ CountBy #39604
    community-contribution
  • Translate string.Trim with characters to TRIM on SQL Server #39603
    community-contribution
  • Support null versus empty for owned JSON collections #39630
    community-contribution
